name: load-keys-dialog
covers: With no archive open, File > Load TACT Keys… opens the native file dialog, a key file is picked by typing its path, and the status bar reports how many keys were loaded. Needs no game install.

phases.name: open the file dialog
phases.note: KDE's file dialog belongs to xdg-desktop-portal-kde; the config lists it under helpers.

phases.name: pick the key file
phases.note: The filename field has no name; it is the text field holding focus when the dialog opens.

phases.name: keys are loaded
phases.note: A wait step, not a check: step fields expand $SMOKE and check names do not. The status bar names the file it read.

notes: Needs no game install. On Linux the config needs helpers: ["xdg-desktop-portal"]; the app may run on native Wayland or XWayland, because the only typing goes into the dialog. The final no_window check needs a bad-ass-mcp that counts a helper's open dialogs (bad-ass-mcp PR #34); older versions fail it with 'unexpected window'. Linux run 2026-11-12 (SteamOS, KDE): passed on native Wayland and on XWayland. Values are for KDE's dialog only. The GTK portal, macOS and Windows dialogs differ (see the table in smoke/README.md) and are not in this script yet.
